title: A ground spotter with eye contact
lines: The person in the basket is focused on the task.
They can't always see what's happening below.
That's what a ground spotter is for.
Keeping eye contact with the person above, all the time.
Keeping people back, watching traffic, warning in time.
Real safety is the team above and below, together.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
